title: Admissibility of Adaptive Monotone Step-Down Multiple Testing Procedures Under Arbitrary Covariance Dependence
summary: In this paper, we consider the problem of simultaneous testing of multivariate normal means under arbitrary covariance dependence. Specifically, let $\boldsymbol{X}\sim N_n(\boldsymbolθ,\boldsymbolΣ)$, where $\boldsymbolθ\in\mathbb{R}^n$ is unknown and $\boldsymbolΣ$ is a known positive definite covariance matrix. The objective is to test $H_{0i}:θ_i=0$ against $H_{Ai}:θ_i\neq 0$, simultaneously for $i=1,\ldots,n$.
